title: Atlas Dissertation Chapter Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a dissertation chapter (dissertation/*.md). v3 (ADR-0005, issue #57): the dissertation is a FLAT, ordered list of Kapitel. The free tree of atlas.dissnode/2 (Teil/Kapitel/Paper-Slot kinds, arbitrary nesting) is retired — `kind` and `parent` are dropped. A chapter keeps `order` (position in the linear outline), `status`, `publications` (own Publications planned around it) and a Markdown body that doubles as LLM context. The startup migration flattens /2 (and /1) trees depth-first into `order`.

order.description: Position in the flat, linear chapter list (ascending).

publications.description: IDs of the user's own Publications (veroeffentlichungen/*.md) this chapter is planned around. Hanging IDs are warnings, never auto-repaired.
